 How can we copy a page in DASH? 

CAUSE
We have created a page in DASH . Now we need another one, very similar to the first, with very little changes. So the best way would be to copy existing page to a new page with different name, and then do little modifications.

QUESTION

isc.build.level=201505020120
isc.build.date=05/02/15

isc.build.date=05/02/15
